verdict.rationale: Remote documents a white-label partner path for surfacing its workflows inside your own UI (remote-docs-3). Its SDKs embed onboarding and cost-calculator flows as a custom UI or customizable drop-in components (remote-docs-7, remote-docs-8, remote-docs-9), and OAuth lets partners act on behalf of consenting companies (remote-docs-11). The API also pushes and pulls payroll inputs and payroll data (remote-docs-2). Missing for 10: explicit docs showing payroll itself (not just onboarding or calculators) as an embeddable white-label flow, details of partner program terms, a published OpenAPI spec, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
